parameters.name: BillOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the account that owns and actually uses the resource.

parameters.name: BillingDate
parameters.description: The billing date. This parameter is required only when you set Granularity to DAILY. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: Granularity
parameters.description:
The granularity for querying the bill. Valid values:

- MONTHLY: Queries bills on a monthly basis. Corresponds to the monthly bills in **Expenses & Costs
**> **Bills
**> **Bill Details
**.

- DAILY: Queries bills on a daily basis. Corresponds to the daily bills in **Expenses & Costs
**> **Bills
**> **Bill Details
**.

> If you set `Granularity` to `DAILY`, you must also specify the `BillingDate` parameter.

parameters.name: IsGroupByProduct
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to aggregate the results by product code.

- true: Results are aggregated by product code.

- false: Results are not aggregated by product code.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The default value is 20. The maximum value is 300.
